## Goal

Describe one concrete behavior to implement.

## Scope

List affected modules and explicit limits.

## Concept to understand

Explain the concept in your own words before closing the task.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Implement the stated behavior.
- [ ] Verify the reference case and meaningful failure boundaries.
- [ ] Record the actual command, result, commit and limitations.
- [ ] Explain the retained code and design decisions without notes.

## Evidence

Pending. Planning or mock results must not be reported as live application success.
